name: Case Carnal Corruption
source:
You are a detective, and there's a mystery afoot. Missing people, wild orgies, and a missing partner. Can you find your partner and the source of this sexual corruption? Or will they remain forever lost? 

Join our bunny detective as he looks into various cases on this corruption in hopes of finding the answers to what is really going on in this city.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/case-carnal-corruption]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名侦探，眼下有桩谜案等着调查。有人失踪，城里还发生了狂野的群交，而你的搭档也不见了。你能找到搭档和这场淫乱堕落的源头吗？还是他们会永远消失？

加入兔子侦探的行列，调查这座城市里一桩桩堕落案件，找出真相。

[来源：[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/case-carnal-corruption]Itch.io[/url]]
